worked_solution:
We have that

$$
f(x)≈{P}_{3}(x)=2-\frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{4}{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{6}{x}^{3}.
$$

Therefore, we can approximate $g(x)={\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t$ by integrating the above polynomial term-by-term, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}g(x) & ={\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & ≈{\int }_{0}^{x}(2-\frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{4}{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{6}{x}^{3})\text{d}t \\  & ={[2t-\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}+\frac{1}{12}{t}^{3}-\frac{1}{24}{t}^{4}]}_{0}^{x} \\  & =[2x-\frac{1}{4}{x}^{2}+\frac{1}{12}{x}^{3}-\frac{1}{24}{x}^{4}]-0 \\  & =2x-\frac{1}{4}{x}^{2}+\frac{1}{12}{x}^{3}-\frac{1}{24}{x}^{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate $g(1)$ using the approximation above:

$$
\begin{aligned}g(1) & ≈2(1)-\frac{1}{4}(1)^{2}+\frac{1}{12}(1)^{3}-\frac{1}{24}(1)^{4} \\  & =2-\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{12}-\frac{1}{24} \\  & =\frac{43}{24}\end{aligned}
$$
